arabic text: LAADLA HAIDER KA ZAHRA KI DUA ABBAS HAI
english translation text: Abbas is Haider's beloved and Zahra's prayer; loyalty itself is proud of the faithful Abbas.

arabic text: HAI JAWAAN BHAI KA GHAM TAQDEER DIKHLAEGI AB\nYOON LAGA SHABIR KO DHARKAN YEH RUK JAAYEGI AB\nIZN JAB MAIDAAN KO LEKAR CHALA ABBAS HAI
english translation text: Destiny would now show the grief of losing a young brother;\nit seemed to Shabbir that his heartbeat would stop\nwhen Abbas took permission and departed for the battlefield.

arabic text: HUBAHU BETA ALI KA SAB KO LAGTA HAI ALI\nHAIDER E KARBOBALA HAI YEH ALAMDARE JARI\nSANI E HAIDER HARAM KA AASRA ABBAS HAI
english translation text: He appears exactly like Ali to everyone;\nhe is the Haider of Karbala, the courageous standard-bearer.\nThe second Haider and support of the sacred ladies is Abbas.

arabic text: TARBIYAT KA HAIDER E KARAAR KI DEKHA ASAR\nKAR LIYA BE TEGH BHI QABZA JARI NE NEHR PAR\nRAN ME TANHA HAI MAGAR LASHKAR NUMA ABBAS HAI
english translation text: The effect of Haider-e-Karrar's training was clear:\neven without drawing his sword, the warrior seized control of the river.\nHe stands alone in battle, yet resembles an entire army—Abbas.

arabic text: ROKE ZAINAB NE KAHA BHAI KI MERE KHAIR HO\nAB BHALA KIS WAASTE MEHSHAR ME KOI DER HO\nJAB SUNA BE DASHT GOREH SE GHIRA ABBAS HAI
english translation text: Weeping, Zainab said: may my brother remain safe.\nWhat delay could there now be in Judgement Day,\nwhen she heard that Abbas was surrounded in the wilderness?

arabic text: DOOR SE DEKHA ALAM SHABIR NE GIRTE HUWE\nCHALDIYE MAQTAL KI JAANIB WOH QAMAR THAME HUWE\nDE RAHA BHAI KO MAQTAL SE SADA ABBAS HAI
english translation text: From afar, Shabbir saw the standard falling;\nclutching his back, he walked towards the battlefield.\nFrom the battlefield, Abbas called out to his brother.

arabic text: NEHR SE AATE HUWE DEKHA SAKINA NE ALAM\nBE KHABAR THI SHAHZADI HOGAYE BAZU KALAM\nYOON LAGA BACHI KO PAANI LAA RAHA ABBAS HAI
english translation text: Sakina saw the standard returning from the river,\nunaware that both arms had been severed.\nThe child thought Abbas was bringing water.

arabic text: SHAH BOLE AB SAKINA APNE KUZE TORDE\nAB SAKINA SE KAHO TA UMR WOH PYASI RAHE\nNEHR PE BAZU KATA KE SOGAYA ABBAS HAI
english translation text: The King said: Sakina, now break your little cup;\ntell Sakina she must remain thirsty for the rest of her life.\nAbbas has severed his arms and fallen asleep beside the river.

arabic text: NOHA GHAZI KA JO LIKHA HAI ATAA E SHAHE DEEN\nAB QALAM KA SAR MERE SALMAN JHUK SAKTA NAHI\nBAR SARE QIRTAS MAINE LIKH DIYA ABBAS HAI
english translation text: The lament I wrote for Ghazi is a gift from the King of Faith.\nNow, O "Salman", the head of my pen can never bow,\nfor upon the page I have written the name Abbas.
